title: discrete marching cubes
explanation:
### Description

Generate labeled blob isosurfaces using vtkDiscreteMarchingCubes with a rotated direction matrix, random color lookup table, and an outline.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkDiscreteMarchingCubes](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDiscreteMarchingCubes.html) — discrete marching cubes.
- [vtkImageData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageData.html) — represents a regular grid of points (image/volume).
- [vtkImageDataOutlineFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageDataOutlineFilter.html) — generates an outline of an image dataset.
- [vtkImageMathematics](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMathematics.html) — performs mathematical operations on image data.
- [vtkImageThreshold](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageThreshold.html) — thresholds an image, replacing values inside/outside a range.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkMath](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMath.html) — provides mathematical utility functions.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkSampleFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSampleFunction.html) — evaluates an implicit function on a regular grid.
- [vtkSphere](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphere.html) — defines an implicit sphere function.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
